about: The CBOR codec's mutants. Killers are the examples suite (examples:cborpack: its tests, the RFC 8949 Appendix A examples, and its cases); each rule names the test that kills it.

mutants.name: npj-head-edge-24
mutants.rule: HeadsAtTheirEdges: an argument of 24 takes the one-byte form 0x18 24; no case of the program writes one.

mutants.name: npj-negative-off-by-one
mutants.rule: NegativesAndOtherItems: a negative n is major type 1 with argument -1-n; the program's sample has no negative.
